svg.title: The Complex — Zaziopath systems map
svg.desc: A professionally typeset systems map of the Zaziopath vault. The top row traces self through the shadow engine and stewardship. Five supporting systems—practice, specimens, mythography, recursion, and evidence—feed a single convergence. An indexed register preserves seventeen non-terminal wires without crossing lines.
svg.text: Every wire, one legible map — from interior system to observable behaviour.
when insight becomes control of meaning
twelve questions before sending or signing
local AI · creative code · archive glue
Traits crosswalked · schemes under glass · worlds entered and left freely.
All 17 non-terminal strange wires, indexed instead of overprinted. Read source → mechanism → destination.
turns inner parts into holdable lore
turns quiet rhetorics outward as tools
permutes identical material into new selves
uses the same craft, aimed outward
fuels the tribunal that reads it back
holds machine memory in two directions
